definitions.sites_found: production LLM sites: API calls (chat, responses, messages, embeddings, images...) and framework model constructions; tests/examples/evals excluded
definitions.migrated: sites whose traffic goes to Router when RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY is set (client patched, surface served by Router, model in catalog or chosen at runtime)
definitions.handoff: sites that need an agent-made code change (other-vendor SDK whose model Router serves, raw HTTP, other gateways)
definitions.kept: sites that stay on their provider by design (no Router endpoint, e.g. embeddings; or another vendor's endpoint)
definitions.flagged: sites Router could serve but the tool does not move automatically (unmapped model, beta API, server-side state)
definitions.weighted_coverage: migrated / Router-eligible sites (generation surfaces Router can serve)
definitions.tests_before/after: the repo's own offline test suite (or typecheck where it has none), Router off, before vs after migrating
definitions.sim_valid_pct: valid / total requests at router-sim from (a) the repo's tests run with Router on and (b) one synthetic replay per migrated site
definitions.live_success_pct: same replay against api.router.com (null when not run)

repos.test_cmd: mkdir -p "$ENV/home" "$ENV/tmp" && HOME="$ENV/home" TMPDIR="$ENV/tmp" $PY -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/
